content: In recent years, gender has become a hot topic within the political, societal and research spheres. Numerous studies have been conducted in order to evaluate the presence of women in media, often revealing their under-representation, such as the Global Media Monitoring Project BIBREF0. In the French context, the CSA BIBREF1 produces a report on gender representation in media on a yearly basis. The 2017 report shows that women represent 40% of French media speakers, with a significant drop during high-audience hours (6:00-8:00pm) reaching a value of only 29%. Another large scale study confirmed this trend with an automatic analysis of gender in French audiovisuals streams, highlighting a huge variation across type of shows BIBREF2.
